q1.prompt: You need a stable O(n log n) sort in the worst case. Which algorithm family?

choices.label: Mergesort — guaranteed n log n and preserves equal-key order
Quicksort with no pivot strategy discussion

wrong_quick.explanation: Mergesort keeps O(n log n) worst case and is stable. Quicksort needs a pivot story if worst-case behavior is under discussion.

q2.prompt: Which requirement rules out the proposed sort?

choices.label: Do not ship quicksort without a pivot strategy if worst case matters; do not use plain counting sort on arbitrary strings
Any comparison sort is fine for every constraint

wrong_refuse.explanation: Do not ship quicksort without a pivot strategy if worst-case behavior is under discussion. Do not apply plain counting sort to arbitrary strings without a radix plan.

success.prompt: You picked mergesort for stable worst-case bounds and avoided weak pivot stories.
